foundations.title: Get the fundamentals right
foundations.description: Arrays, strings, hash maps, searching, sorting, stacks, and queues. Learn to choose a useful starting point.

foundations.title: Think beyond the happy path
foundations.description: Recursion, sets, trees, and traversal. Compare approaches and test empty, invalid, and boundary inputs.

foundations.title: Explain under pressure
foundations.description: Introductory graphs, mixed problems, and technical walkthroughs. Practise communicating before reaching for code.

interview.title: Walk through your code
interview.description: Explain how a request moves from React to your API, database, and AI workflow.

interview.title: Debug out loud
interview.description: Describe what you observe, form a hypothesis, and use evidence to find the issue.

interview.title: Defend a decision
interview.description: Explain why you used retrieval, where an agent helped, and when simpler code was enough.
